day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSaint Jerome, uMprista noGqirha weBandla
greeting: Igama likaYise, neloNdodana, neloMoya Oyingcwele. Makube noxolo lwasezulwini kunye nobubele bukaThixo phakathi kwethu namhlanje.
penitential:
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kutha.
Kristu, yiba nenceba kutha.
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kutha.
psalm_response: Makufike phambi kwakho umthandazo wam, Nkosi.
homily:
Kukho izinto ezincinci esizibona emhlabeni ezingena nzulu kakhulu ezintliziyweni zethu. Cinga ngomzuzu wokuhlala phantsi ebusuku, kwigumbi elithuleyo, xa uva ilizwi lomntwana wakho omncinci esiza phezulu ngezitepsi, esithi ngelizwi elithambileyo: 'Molo, Ba.' Alikho ixesha emhlabeni elingaphezu kwaloo mzuzu. Kwaye xa eloo lizwi lithule ngokungathi akukho mntu usakhulumayo kule ndlu, intliziyo iyazibuza: 'Siphi na isandi?' Kwiinyanga ezintathu ezidlulileyo, ukususela ngaloo mhla we-13 kaJuni 2026, uBenjamin Vo ushiye izandla zakhe emhlabeni waza waya ekhaya kuThixo. Namhlanje, kwiSikhumbuzo sikaSaint Jerome, umntu owayesazi incwadi yezibhalo, umntu owazinikela ekufundeni ilizwi likaThixo, sijonge kweli lizwi ukuze sifumane amandla okuhlala sime ngenyawo.

KwiNcwadi kaYobhi, siyaziva iintlungu zomntu owaphulukana nazo zonke izinto. UYobhi uthi: 'Ndiya kwazi kakuhle ukuba kunjalo; kodwa umntu angalungiselelwa njani phambi koThixo?' UYobhi uthetha ngobukhulu bukaThixo, ngamandla akhe angagungqiyo. Uyazibuza ukuba ngubani onokumelana naye, ngubani onokuthi kuye, 'Ukwenza ntoni na?' La magama kaYobhi ayenzima kakhulu, awafihli lutho. Ayasixelela inyaniso enqabileyo: ukuba amaxesha amaninzi ubomi buyasigubungela ngamafu amnyama, kwaye akukho mpendulo ilula esiyifumanayo ngoko nangoko. UYobhi ukhala, enjengokuba nabani na oziva ubuhlungu obukhulu ekhala.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba indlu isenokuziva ithule ngendlela ebuhlungu kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayephila ngobuhle, owayenomdla ongalinganiswayo wokwazi izinto—lowo wayefuna ukwenza inqwelo-moya ebizwa ngokuba yi-'con chim airlines' aze ancume kancinci xa athetha ngayo—akukho xesha lonyaka linokuzisa ukuthula ngokukhawuleza. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

KwiVangeli kaLuka, sibona uYesu nabafundi bakhe basendleleni. Umntu uthi kuYesu: 'Ndiza kukulandela naphi na apho unga khona.' Kodwa uYesu amphendule ngamazwi anzulu: 'Iimpungutye zinemiqolomba, neentaka zezulu zinezidleke, kodwa uNyana woMntu agenandawo yokuphumza intloko yakhe.' UYesu usibonisa ukuba ukumlandela akusoloko kulula; kubiza konke esinakho. Kwaye komunye umntu owathi ufuna ukuqala aye kungcwaba uyise, uYesu uthi: 'Vumela abafileyo bangcwabe abafileyo babo; kodwa wena hamba uye kumzabalaza ubukumkani bukaThixo.' Apha, uYesu akathethi ngokungabi nabubele kubazali; uthetha ngobomi obumele buqonde ukuba uThixo uqala ngaphambi kweento zonke. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto ngendlela yakhe emsulwa. Wayengumfana owayezimisele ukunikela ngayo yonke into. Khumbula loo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka nje eli-15 ubudala, athetha nabazali bakhe athi ufuna ukunikela yonke imali yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala.

... Yima kancinci apha. Cinga ngaloo mphuphu yothando eyayisentliziyweni kaBenjamin Vo. Wayengumfana owayezisa uvuyo olukhulu kubazali bakhe, umfana owayenentliziyo evulekileyo. U-Alan, utata wakhe, wake waphupha ngoBen ngexesha lonyaka: uBen wayemile ngaphandle komnyango weroom 419, ebila, esithi: 'Ba ơi, test nào con cũng qua hết. Con tự thở được bình thường mà... sao con lại bị như vầy?' Kwaye utata wakhe wamwola waza wathi: 'Từ nay trở đi, con sẽ ở trên Thiên Đàng mãi mãi.' Kwaye uBen wamamatheka wathi: 'Không sao đâu, con sẽ dõi theo ba mẹ.' 

Loo mzuzu usemhlabeni namhlanje. UBen akalahlekanga; ukunye noThixo, ubonisela abazali bakhe nomfowethu uRyan. Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana onobubele, onethemba, oqhubeka nohambo lwenu oludibeneyo. UBen uqhubeka ekhanya, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi owakhiwe eCà Mau ngeligama lakhe—umthombo owenza ukuba abantu abaselubundini bafumane ubomi. Uthando lukaBen aluzange lufe; luyaphila, luqukuqela, kwaye luhamba nani ngalo lonke ixesha.

Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. Xa usizi luhlasela, thabatha elo lizwi likaYesu, uthi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Siya kukukhumbula njalo, side sidibane kwakhona apho kungekho nyembezi, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliCheshileyo leAltare. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kweento zonke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba uze entliziyweni yam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngendlela yomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndibonana nawe ngokupheleleyo; musa ukundivumela ukuba ndahlukane nawe nakancinci. Amen.
closing: Makube ngaba uThixo usisibane seendlela zenu namhlanje nakwezi ntsuku zizayo, egcina usapho lonke lusebunjeni bakhe. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sikhulekela umfana wethu uBenjamin kunye nabo bonke abaphumlelileyo kuThixo, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sikhulekela bonke abasiziweyo nabasentslungwini, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingenakuphela.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: UYobhi waphendula abahlobo bakhe wathi: Ndiyazi kakuhle ukuba kunjalo; kodwa umntu angalungiselelwa njani phambi koThixo? Ukuba umntu angathanda ukuqina naye, angangena emacaleni akhe kanye kwiwaka. UThixo unobulumko bentliziyo namandla amakhulu; ngubani omi phambi kwakhe waphila? Ususa iintaba zingazi; uziphenqula ngumsindwakazi wakhe. Unyakazisa ihlabathi ezindaweni zalo, nezinsika zalo ziyagungqa. Uyayiyalela ilanga ukuba lingaphumi, kwaye uyazitywina iinkwenkwezi. Nguye yedwa olula izulu aphinde anyathele phezu kwamaza olwandle. Wenza iUrsa major neOrion, iPleiades nezihlwele zasemazantsi; wenza izinto ezinkulu ezingenakuhlolisiswa, nezinto ezimangalisayo ezingenakuqondwa. Ukuba angasondela kum, andimboni; ukuba angadlula, andimazi. Ukuba angandibamba ngamandla, ngubani onokumtsalisa? Ngubani onokuthi kuye, 'Ukwenza ntoni na?' Wobeka phi ukumphendula, okanye ukukhetha amagama okuxoxa naye? Nokuba bendilungile, bendingenakumphendula, kodwa bendingabetha izandla ndicela ubulungisa bakhe. Ukuba bendibize waza wandiphendula, bendingenakukholwa ukuba uyaliphulaphula ilizwi lam.

readings.label: IHubo lokuphendula
readings.text:
R. Makufike phambi kwakho umthandazo wam, Nkosi.
Imihla yonke ndiyakubiza, Nkosi; ndiphakamisela izandla zam kuwe.
Uzakwenza izimanga kwabafileyo na? Izithunzi ziya kusuka zivuke zikubulele na?
R. Makufike phambi kwakho umthandazo wam, Nkosi.
Kuthiwa na ububele bakho engcwabeni, nokunyaniseka kwakho kwabo batshabalalayo?
Kumenywa izimanga zakho emnyameni, okanye ubulungisa bakho elizweni lokulibala?
R. Makufike phambi kwakho umthandazo wam, Nkosi.
Kodwa mna, Nkosi, ndikhala kuwe; ngumthandazo wentsasa endilindela ngawo kuwe.
Yini madoda, Nkosi, ukuba undilahle; yini ukuba ufihle ubuso bakho kum?
R. Makufike phambi kwakho umthandazo wam, Nkosi.

readings.label: I-Vangeli
readings.text: Kuthe besendleleni kunye nabafundi bakhe, kwakho owathi kuye, 'Ndiza kukulandela naphi na apho unga khona.' UYesu wamphendula wathi, 'Iimpungutye zinemiqolomba, neentaka zezulu zinezidleke, kodwa uNyana woMntu agenandawo yokuphumza intloko yakhe.' Wathi nakomnye, 'Ndilandele.' Ke yena wathi, 'Nkosi, ndiyeke ndiqale ndiye kungcwaba utata wam.' UYesu wathi kuye, 'Vumela abafileyo bangcwabe abafileyo babo; kodwa wena hamba uye kumzabalaza ubukumkani bukaThixo.' Wakho omunye owathi, 'Ndiza kukulandela, Nkosi, kodwa mandiqale ndiye kubavazisa abo basendlini yam.' UYesu wathi kuye, 'Akukho namnye othi abeke isandla sakhe eploweni aze ajonge emva owandelelwe ubukumkani bukaThixo.'

day: Memorial of Saint Jerome, Priest and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
